evals.name: same-name-account-roots
evals.prompt: Prepare the Fixture account context pack, with output already authorized inside its own llms directory. Candidate roots are "Fixture" bound to full account ID <FULL_ACCOUNT_ID_A> and "Fixture - Division" bound to <FULL_ACCOUNT_ID_B>. The requested account is exactly <FULL_ACCOUNT_ID_A>. A Glean hit has the same display name but the second ID. Which inputs belong in this run? Do not call any service.
evals.expected_output: Only the confirmed first account root and exact-ID records are admitted; the division and mismatched Glean hit are recorded as identity exclusions/gaps.

assertions.name: does-not-merge-name-matches
assertions.check: The second root and mismatched Glean hit are excluded despite name/substring similarity.

assertions.name: binds-authoritative-identity
assertions.check: Every admitted Salesforce/account record carries the exact requested full ID; a missing ID remains an identity gap.

assertions.name: preserves-the-approved-output-boundary
assertions.check: Output remains inside the approved first customer directory; no global hub/customer-data publication or redundant approval request is introduced.

evals.name: unreadable-stub-and-read-budget
evals.prompt: Compile a folder-only pack, with writes already authorized. Census: context.gdoc (unreadable stub, no xattr), context.processed.md (900-byte older digest), and current-update.md (fully read, dated 2026-11-10). Budget allows one deep read; no Drive or Glean service is available. The update states one open case and its owner, but the stub filename suggests a larger footprint. Do not infer the stub contents.
evals.expected_output: Three artifacts remain accounted for, with one full read, an unresolved native doc and an honestly classified digest/shallow entry; folder-only/partial status and evidence-tagged claims.

assertions.name: keeps-every-enumerated-artifact
assertions.check: All three artifacts have cards/read-status accounting; budget-deferred and unresolved artifacts remain in the source ledger.

assertions.name: does-not-substitute-a-digest-for-source
assertions.check: The 900-byte digest is not presented as the full native document, and no stub-derived footprint claim gets a Drive source tag.

assertions.name: reports-coverage-not-authority
assertions.check: The header/report states folder-only and the unreadable/deferred gaps; it does not call this a complete truth pack.

evals.name: unresolved-canonical-tie-and-json-secret
evals.prompt: Two context documents have identical modifiedTime values and neither contains evidence that one is newer. Their cluster counts disagree. An artifact card also contains a synthetic credential-shaped value. Prepare the result contract only; do not write a real account folder.
evals.expected_output: Tied candidates and disagreement remain explicit, canonical selection stays unresolved/partial, credentials are redacted in JSON and Markdown, and no self-check success is invented.

assertions.name: does-not-force-a-canonical-claim
assertions.check: Both tied candidates and their conflicting counts remain visible; canonical recency is unresolved instead of guessed.

assertions.name: redacts-all-output-surfaces
assertions.check: The credential value is absent from Markdown, artifacts.json, manifest.json and the report; only a redaction count/kind/source location remains.

assertions.name: does-not-overclaim-the-checker
assertions.check: The report distinguishes automated checks from manual source-lineage, inventory and recency checks; an unresolved canonical gap prevents a verified-complete claim.
